permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Send voice recordings, messages and selected photos to your own Mac relay, and receive replies from your existing Dot.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Record your voice with the G2 microphones for messages to Dot. Hold-to-record captures up to 30 seconds. Voice activation keeps the G2 microphone open while active to detect the cue on your phone; only speech after the cue is sent for transcription.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Read your phone location to share it with Dot through your Mac when you enable sharing. Your Mac caches nearby map data, which can reveal past areas, until unused for 30 days. Turn sharing off to stop new location sharing.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Use your phone camera to take a photo for a message to Dot when you tap the camera button. The photo stays in your draft until you tap Send or complete voice input with automatic sending enabled.

permissions.name: album
permissions.desc: Use your phone photo picker to select a photo for a message to Dot. The photo stays in your draft until you tap Send or complete voice input with automatic sending enabled.
